title: Figure 14: Illustration of the thermocouple principle (Seebeck voltage)
description: Blue presentation slide titled "Blood Glucose Sensors for Diabetic Monitoring and Biochemical Analyses" showing a yellow-line thermocouple with "Metal A" and "Metal B" joined at a "Measuring Junction" (T1) and a "Reference Junction" (T2), with output terminals labeled "Seebeck Voltage." Text on the slide states "Seebeck Voltage = Thermoelectric EMF (T1 - T2)" and "Thermoelectric EMF of Antimony/Bismuth = 119 µV/°C." The caption reads "Figure 14. Illustration of the Thermocouple Principle (Guilbeau and Towe, ASU)."
